newsitem.title: FRANCE: Two bomb blasts in Corsica, no casualties.
newsitem.headline: Two bomb blasts in Corsica, no casualties.

text.p: Two bombs exploded in Corsica overnight causing slight damage but no casualties, French police said on Monday.
The attacks occurred at banks in the southern town of Porto-Vecchio.
No one has claimed responsibility for the attacks but they followed similar bombings on the previous two nights at banks in other parts of the troubled Mediterranean island.
Separatist guerrillas have been waging a long-running campaign for greater autonomy from France.
